mapper.select: SELECT analysis_id AS id,audio_path AS audioPath FROM speech_analyses WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND audio_path IS NOT NULL

SELECT m.message_id AS id,m.audio_path AS audioPath FROM conversation_messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.conversation_id=m.conversation_id WHERE c.student_id=#{studentId} AND m.audio_path IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE speech_analyses SET audio_path=NULL,audio_deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,audio_delete_error=NULL WHERE analysis_id=#{id} AND audio_path IS NOT NULL
UPDATE speech_analyses SET audio_delete_attempts=audio_delete_attempts+1,audio_delete_error=#{error} WHERE analysis_id=#{id} AND audio_path IS NOT NULL
UPDATE conversation_messages SET audio_path=NULL,audio_deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id=#{id} AND audio_path IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM speech_analyses WHERE audio_path=#{path}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_messages WHERE audio_path=#{path})
